{{Top|leg|italics=1}}
'''''Ackbar: Wartime Correspondence, volume 8''''', was the eighth volume of a collection of messages and war-related correspondence supplied by the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|fleet]], [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]]. This collection included a message from Ackbar to his niece, [[Jesmin Ackbar]], regarding why it is necessary to allow former Imperials to defect into the Rebel Alliance in [[6 ABY/Legends|6 ABY]].<ref name="TEGtW">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The correspondences were first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].
